subject.title: Auto-apply safe doctor fixes on gateway start

question: Which doctor repair mutations may Gateway startup run unattended, and should any security-, channel-, provider-, auth-, or plugin-affecting repair require explicit opt-in?
rationale: Source inspection shows the requested behavior is absent, but current doctor repair can mutate security and delivery-sensitive config; only maintainers can set the product/security boundary for unattended startup repair.

options.title: Classify a safe startup subset
options.body: Define an unattended-safe allowlist, keep broad doctor repair manual, and require redacted audit logging plus backup details for any startup writes.

options.title: Explicit opt-in auto-fix
options.body: Add a compatibility-reviewed config or CLI policy knob that enables broader startup repair only for operators who accept the security and delivery tradeoff.

options.title: Keep manual repair only
options.body: Document systemd/launchd preflight patterns and close startup auto-repair as out of core until the broader Gateway recovery design is settled.

recommendation.title: Classify a safe startup subset
recommendation.body: Define an unattended-safe allowlist, keep broad doctor repair manual, and require redacted audit logging plus backup details for any startup writes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Gateway startup and doctor repair boundaries that need the policy decision.
